column5: The retained endpoint worker now sends GetPrevRegion to the active endpoint, refreshes and retries only the PD leader after failure, preserves need_buckets, and validates response headers and topology before projection. Router streaming, forwarding, TLS, metrics, and live PD validation remain external.

The retained client now completes previous-region queries through the endpoint worker with active-endpoint then leader-only failover and validated projection. Production QueryRegion streaming, follower/router service selection, and live failover remain external.

Previous-region requests now preserve the encoded previous key, need_buckets, owned terminal completion, and validated projection through one retained worker. Request pooling, tracing, router streaming, and live cancellation remain external.
